messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tirzepatide is a once-weekly injection.
It is available as two brands.
One brand is Zepbound.
Zepbound is for weight loss, weight management, and obstructive sleep apnea.
The other brand is Mounjaro.
Mounjaro is for type 2 diabetes.
Mounjaro is also to lower the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events.
This risk reduction applies to those with type 2 diabetes at high risk.
Zepbound (tirzepatide) is FDA-approved for weight loss and weight management in adults with obesity.
It is also approved for overweight adults with at least one weight-related medical condition.
Zepbound is also approved to treat moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) in adults with obesity.
Mounjaro (tirzepatide) is FDA-approved for type 2 diabetes in adults and children aged 10 years and older.
It is used to help improve blood sugar (glucose) levels.
It is used alongside diet and exercise.
Mounjaro is approved to lower the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events.
These events include cardiovascular death, non-fatal heart attack, or non-fatal stroke.
Triplet: ["Zepbound", "has fda approval", "overweight adults with at least one weight-related medical condition"]

The relation 'has fda approval' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is approved by the FDA for the indication or patient population specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is approved for': The subject drug has received FDA approval for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
C. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
D. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
